# OpenOCR

> Research-grade, zero-selection document intelligence platform for commercial invoices, receipts, identity documents, and financial reports. Runs on pure CPU (<20MB RAM) and is 100% air-gapped VPC capable.

## Core Capabilities
- **Zero Schema Selection:** Automatically detects document type, normalizes orientation, parses reading order and tabular grids, and extracts typed key-value pairs without manual template building.
- **Two-Stage Processing:** IBM Docling layout parser with PaddleOCR/RapidOCR fallbacks, followed by isolated LLM post-processing with mathematical reconciliation.
- **Pure CPU Inference:** Optimized for x86_64 AVX2 CPUs (<500ms per page). No GPU required.
- **Air-Gapped Sovereign Deployment:** Zero telemetry, zero external network egress in self-hosted mode.

## Canonical URLs & Documentation
- [Homepage & Light Table Playground](https://openocr.io/): Interactive document extraction interface and specimen archive.
- [Developer Documentation & API Reference](https://openocr.io/docs): Complete RESTful API specification, endpoints, SDK code snippets, and schemas.
- [Rate Card & Pricing](https://openocr.io/pricing): Free Explorer ($0), Developer Pro ($49/mo), Enterprise Self-Hosted ($499/mo).
- [Self-Hosted Solution](https://openocr.io/self-hosted): Docker Compose and Helm architecture schematics for air-gapped VPCs.
- [Customer Support Portal](https://openocr.io/support): Plan-based priority issue resolution and ticket tracking.

## API Endpoints
- `POST /v1/extract`: Synchronous and asynchronous document extraction via multipart form-data or storage key.
- `GET /v1/jobs/{id}`: Poll asynchronous extraction status and fetch structured results.
- `POST /v1/uploads/sign`: Request pre-signed S3/MinIO upload URL for files over 10MB (up to 100MB).
- `GET /v1/health`: Cluster health, engine availability, and uptime checks.

## Supported File Types
- PDF (multi-page up to 50 pages cloud, unlimited self-hosted)
- PNG, JPEG/JPG, WEBP, TIFF (up to 100MB via signed storage)

## Security & Verification
- HMAC-SHA256 signatures on webhook events (`X-OpenOCR-Signature: t={timestamp},v1={hex}`) with 300s replay window.
- Argon2id password and API key hashing (`ocr_live_*` and `ocr_test_*`).
- Zero document retention option; default 24-hour TTL before permanent deletion.
